patterns.message: @transit/core must not depend on other workspace packages (see docs/engineering/architecture.md).
@transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port and implement it in an adapter.

paths.react: @transit/core must not depend on UI frameworks.
paths.react-native: @transit/core must not depend on UI frameworks.
paths.fs: @transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port.
paths.path: @transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port.
paths.crypto: @transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port.
paths.http: @transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port.
paths.https: @transit/core is pure TypeScript: put I/O behind a port.

paths.@transit/contracts: Adapters produce domain objects; mapping to contracts belongs to apps/server.
paths.@transit/api-client: Adapters must not call the public API.
paths.react: Adapters are Node-only and must not depend on UI frameworks.
paths.react-native: Adapters are Node-only and must not depend on UI frameworks.
paths.expo: Adapters are Node-only and must not depend on Expo.
paths.next: Adapters must not depend on Next.js.

paths.@transit/core: Public contracts and the API client must not depend on the domain layer.
paths.@transit/gtfs: Public contracts and the API client must not depend on adapters.

paths.@transit/core: The mobile app must not import the domain layer. Use @transit/api-client and @transit/contracts.
paths.@transit/gtfs: The mobile app must not import data adapters. Use @transit/api-client and @transit/contracts.
